taskPacket.objective: When a provider's stream ends with no completion event, the claude, codex and agy normalizers report the process's own stderr instead of only an empty-stream message.
instructions: NormalizeOptions (scripts/drivers/index.mjs) carries an optional stderr string.

normalizeClaudeResult, normalizeAgyResult and normalizeCodexResult (scripts/drivers/protocol.mjs) append the trimmed stderr, bounded to 512 bytes, to their incomplete_stream message when the stream carries no completion event; with no stderr the message is unchanged.
recordInvocationUsage (scripts/node.mjs) passes the stderr tail it already reads to normalizeProviderResult.
A drivers test pins a codex config-load error reaching the message, and the unchanged message without stderr.
nonGoals: Changing how much of the stderr log the invocation path reads: it keeps its existing 512 KiB tail.
